title: The Weather Today
text:
Today the weather is very nice. The sun is shining and the sky is blue. There are no clouds. It is warm, so people wear t-shirts and shorts.

Yesterday it was cold and rainy. Tomorrow it will be windy. Bring a warm coat when you go out.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What was the weather like yesterday?
Why do people probably feel comfortable outside today?
What should you probably do before going out tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: white or grey shapes in the sky
when the air moves fast and strongly
when water falls from the sky

paragraph_translations: Hoje o tempo está muito agradável. O sol está brilhando e o céu está azul. Não há nuvens. Está quente, então as pessoas usam camisetas e shorts.
Ontem estava frio e chuvoso. Amanhã vai ser ventoso. Leve um casaco quente quando sair.
